commands.review_summary:
The branch adds an in-call flag in Codex plugin thread config to skip later app inventory refreshes and changes three existing Codex tests to `it.skip`.

PR surface: Source +13, Tests +9. Total +22 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for the PR regression by source inspection: after a non-forced initial refresh, PR head sets the new flag and can skip the forced not-ready repair. I did not live-run the original disk-I/O symptom.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The external PR needs author or maintainer revision plus real behavior proof before merge; ClawSweeper should not auto-repair while the contributor proof gate is unmet.
